question: Which language is a descendant of Sanskrit and is influenced by the languages of Dravidian, Arabic, Portuguese, English, Persian and Turkey?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hindi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Descendant of Sanskrit: **Hindi is an Indo-Aryan language derived from the ancient language Sanskrit.
 
• **Influences**: Over time, Hindi has been influenced by Dravidian languages, Arabic, Persian, Turkish, Portuguese, and English.
 
• **Linguistic Evolution:** These influences came through trade, invasions, and colonization, enriching the Hindi vocabulary and grammar.
 
• **Script and Structure:** Hindi is written in the Devanagari script, which also traces its roots back to ancient scripts derived from Brahmi.
 
• **Cultural Significance:** Today, Hindi is one of the most spoken languages in India and serves as a lingua franca among diverse linguistic communities.
